0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Scarlett getting a free pick on Steel late, once he was already ahead, is the one blemish in an otherwise strong offlane game: farm well above his usual rate, the most mitigated damage on the roster, and a low death count while trading kills as the late lane read broke his way. Bring backup or ward up before wandering alone once ahead, so a game played this well doesn't hand away a free kill.

0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Khaimera put up real objective damage and held his kill-to-death line even as the jungle read trended unfavored late against Greystone. Getting caught alone twice early, by Greystone and by Scarlett, before either fight started, is the problem. Stop getting caught alone early; bring someone along or clear vision before those early skirmishes. Placements also sat below his usual mark on this hero, but whether it was wards or sentries, those two solo deaths are the fix that matters.
